# Other modules, copied into the fork

A module here is a copy of the module's own version, file for file, that the fork builds instead of it (a `replace` in
`go.mod`). The fork's changes in it are marked `// fork:`; FORK.md says what they are, why, and how to move the copy to
a newer version. Each module keeps its own licence files.
